P0.name: Foundational Telemetry & Traceability (Critical)
P0.scope: Mandatory foundational logs required for audit trails and incident reconstruction.

items.name: Kubernetes Audit Logs Enabled
items.requirement: API server audit logging stream active and retained for 1+ year.

items.name: Container Runtime Event Logging
items.requirement: Container start, stop, kill, and exec syscall logs recorded.

items.name: Host Authentication & Access Logs
items.requirement: Node SSH, sudo, and IAM credential assumption telemetry captured.

items.name: Network Flow & Ingress/Egress Logs
items.requirement: VPC/CNI network flow logs enabled for container subnets.

P1.name: Threat Defense & Hardening (High)
P1.scope: High-priority runtime container threat detection and hardening policies.

items.name: Container Privilege Escalation Detection
items.requirement: Block/alert on privileged container launch and CAP_SYS_ADMIN capabilities.

items.name: Container Escape & Mount Abuse Alert
items.requirement: Detect hostpath volume mounts to /etc, /var/run/docker.sock, or /proc.

items.name: Suspicious Exec & Interactive Shells
items.requirement: Alert on interactive bash/sh execution inside production workloads.

items.name: Unsecured Credentials in Memory/Files
items.requirement: Scan for hardcoded tokens, mounted service account token abuse, or Kubelet API dumping.

P2.name: Environmental Adaptive Defense (Medium)
P2.scope: Adaptive anomaly detection, image drift, and policy enforcement.

items.name: Immutable Root Filesystem Enforcement
items.requirement: Enforce read-only root filesystems and alert on post-deployment binary writes.

items.name: Cryptomining & Port Scanning Behavioral Alerts
items.requirement: Detect high CPU anomalies, Stratum protocol, and cluster-internal scanning.

items.name: Untrusted Registry Image Blocker
items.requirement: Admission controller blocking images from unauthorized external registries.

P3.name: Operational Observability & Collaboration (Low)
P3.scope: SIEM correlation, continuous posture benchmarking, and multi-cloud normalization.

items.name: SIEM Unified Telemetry Pipeline
items.requirement: Forward normalized ECS/EKS/AKS/GKE logs into enterprise SIEM.

items.name: Automated CIS Benchmark Scanning
items.requirement: Scheduled weekly CIS Kubernetes benchmark assessment with automated scoring.
